svg.title: Lakebase persona boxer portraits — options sheet one
svg.desc: Two original retro boxing portrait directions each for Backfill Bill, Stacktrace Jack, Count Query, Major Pattern, and Doctor Drift.
svg.text: BOXING SILHOUETTE FIRST · ONE PERSONA CUE · PICK A OR B

g.text: A stocky fighter who keeps every row moving
A long jab that reaches yesterday’s records
Compact high guard · opposing brace cuffs
Closes every opening before throwing the fix
Finds the failing frame without trading chaos
Waits for the number, then makes it matter
Turns every claim into a checked result
Gives every team a safe path into the ring
Maps repeatable routes without blocking choice
Changes stance when the baseline moves
Knows which punch is likely—and when it drifts
